summary: First iteration testing for ZipRide (customer + captain in one Expo app). Backend: 23/23 pytest tests PASS covering auth (OTP mocked, rejects wrong, accepts 1234), profile update with captain KYC auto-verification, fare estimate for ZipBike (base 25 + 8/km) and ZipDelivery (base 40 + 12/km) with minimum-fare clamp, nearby captains (6 pseudo-random), full ride lifecycle (create->get->accept->status transitions reached_pickup/started/completed->rate->history), SOS logging, captain duty toggle, captain earnings aggregation after completed ride, and captain incoming request (returns demo when online, null when offline). Verified no ObjectId (_id) leaks across every response by recursive assertion. Frontend: mobile viewport (390x844) UI tested via Playwright. Full customer flow works — splash -> onboarding (Skip) -> role-select -> phone (9876543210) -> OTP 1234 -> home with MockMap + quick shortcuts -> pick MG Road Metro -> service-bike selection -> confirm-ride-btn -> auto-search completes -> tracking screen renders captain card, OTP (4-digit), Call/Chat/Share/SOS action buttons; SOS modal opens on tap. Full captain flow works — role-captain -> phone -> OTP -> dashboard with duty-toggle + earnings snapshot -> toggling online triggers incoming ride modal with 18-second countdown showing pickup/drop/fare/customer -> accept -> active-ride screen with OTP display (4271) and stage transition button 'I've reached pickup' -> 'Start Ride' progression. No red-screen / runtime errors; no ObjectId leaks; core UX solid.

issues: Auto-progression to payment/rating stages seems to take >25s; agent context said stages progress but the transition to completed within a typical test window (~20s) did not consistently reach payment screen. Consider shortening or exposing a manual next-stage control for demo.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Multiple occurrences on splash/role-select. Update StyleSheet blocks that still use shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset to a cross-platform boxShadow or platform-guarded style.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — search for View/Animated.View components that pass pointerEvents as a prop and move it into style.

action_items: Address deprecated shadow* style props: migrate to boxShadow (or platform-guarded fallback) in components with elevation/shadow (splash, role-select, cards).
Address deprecated pointerEvents prop: move pointerEvents into the style object across all affected View/Animated.View usages.

Optional: shorten timers in customer/tracking.tsx or expose test-only fast-forward for E2E; current auto-progression from tracking->payment appears >25s (multiple stage messages seen: 'Reaching drop in 11 min' then 'Captain arriving in 6 min'). If intentional, document in agent-context note.
Optional UX: add explicit testIDs on onboarding Skip / Next buttons ('onboarding-skip-btn', 'onboarding-next-btn') for more deterministic test automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py all endpoints correctly project out MongoDB _id via {'_id': 0} — verified no leaks.
auth token is a raw UUID stored in DB (fine for demo). For production, consider expiring tokens/JWT.

captain_incoming currently returns any 'searching' ride without captain_id which could match a different customer's real ride and cause cross-contamination in multi-user demo — acceptable for MVP but flag for later.
server.py is 540 lines — still under 700 but growing; consider splitting into modules (auth, rides, captain) before adding features.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows work; deprecation warnings only)

seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users with prefixed TEST_ names and random 10-digit phones per session; no manual seeding required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend .env exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) — use the same URL for backend testing. Public URL: https://captain-driver-app.preview.emergentagent.com. TestIDs discovered: role-customer-btn, role-captain-btn, phone-input, send-otp-btn, otp-input-0..3, verify-otp-btn, quick-dest-<Name>, destination-search-btn, service-bike, service-delivery, confirm-ride-btn, sos-btn, sos-dismiss, action-call/chat/share/sos, cap-menu-btn, duty-toggle, cap-earnings-btn, see-earnings, reject-ride-btn, accept-ride-btn, close-active-ride, next-stage-btn, menu-btn, history-btn. Onboarding Skip button is text-only (no testID). Backend supports mocked OTP=1234 for both roles; any 10-digit phone works.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failing tests. Deprecation warnings originate from react-native-web resolving legacy shadow* props from StyleSheet.create objects; migration is straightforward (replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius with boxShadow string on web, keep native props inside Platform.select if needed).
